designSummary: Narrative synthesis without pooling, organised by evidence class, with ranges and medians.
sampleSize: No sample size applies. An estimated 25 to 40 studies are expected; results are summarised as ranges and medians within each evidence class because vignette sets, apps and versions differ too much for pooling.
primaryAnalysis: Tables of the proportion with correct urgency by evidence class, app and version; median and range within class; the single real-user comparison presented on its own.
secondaryAnalysis: Under-triage of emergencies and over-triage of self-care by class; subgroup results for older adults, children and people with limited English where reported.
missingData: Studies that do not report a needed proportion are described without it; no values are estimated from figures.
overfittingGuards: No ranking of apps from vignette results
summary: Descriptive synthesis by evidence class, no pooling.
